note: Delete-one-file cure from anthropics/claude-code#92345. Official package minus priconfig.xml installs. Diagnostic documentation only — not a shipping hook.
workaround: Unzip the downloaded MSIX (it is a ZIP)
Delete only priconfig.xml from the package root
Leave AppxManifest.xml and all other files untouched
Remove AppxSignature.p7x, AppxBlockMap.xml and [Content_Types].xml (makeappx regenerates them)
drawback: Repacked package carries the reporter's signature instead of Anthropic's, so auto-update will fail and reintroduce the same file. A packaging-side exclude is the real fix.
suggestedFixDocumentOnly: Exclude priconfig.xml from the packaging step. It is a makepri build input, not a runtime asset.
